1.explanation:
• CodeSnippet/CodeSnippet.mdx – the primary Component doc where the new `disabled` prop and its styles should be defined.  
• CopyButton/CopyButton.mdx – CodeSnippet depends on this for the copy control, which must be suppressed when disabled.  
• Button/Button.mdx – for reference on how Carbon defines disabled styles and behavior on buttons (used for the “Sync account” button).  
• TextInput/TextInput.mdx – shows how input fields implement disabled styling and accessibility; CodeSnippet should follow the same pattern.  
• SkeletonPlaceholder/SkeletonPlaceholder.mdx – if a placeholder state is needed before the snippet value is available, referencing Carbon’s skeleton/loading patterns helps ensure consistency and accessibility for the empty state.
1.bug_scenario: The user wants the CodeSnippet component to support a proper “disabled” state. In the first screenshot we see the Twilio account info rendered inside a CodeSnippet with copy-to-clipboard enabled (the copy icon and keyboard focus are active). In the second screenshot, before the credentials are generated, they need the CodeSnippet to appear as a placeholder (empty/greyed out) with the copy button and keyboard focus disabled, similar to how TextInput and Button show disabled states. Right now they only have a custom CSS workaround, but this doesn’t address accessibility (e.g. disabling focus and copy behavior).
